description.en: Safe self-restart for DSH: arms a Windows scheduled-task pair (kill then start) so the app comes back in about 15 seconds and announces when it is back; derives the start script from DSH_HOME or common install paths. Keywords: restart, scheduled task, crash recovery, keep alive. MIT.
description.zh: DSH 安全自重启：排一对 Windows 计划任务（kill + start），重启全程约 15 秒、回来主动播报；start 脚本按 DSH_HOME / 常见安装目录自动推导。关键词：重启 restart、计划任务、崩溃恢复、keep alive、安全重启。MIT。
